name: Tuna Stuffed Jacket Potatoes
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Prick the potatoes all over with a fork and bake for 60 minutes until the skins are crisp and the insides soft.
Drain the tuna and sweetcorn and mix with the mayonnaise, a pinch of pepper and a little salt.
Halve the tomatoes. Split the potatoes, pile in the tuna filling and serve with the tomatoes on the side.
